messages:
sara: Customer (AcmeFinance) reports intermittent 429s from /v1/generate during low steady TPS (~6 rps). Spikes observed around 2026-03-16 22:12 UTC. Need repro artifacts: request IDs, response headers, HAR, curl that reproduces.

tony_oncall: can you paste a sample request-id and exact timestamp? we will check gateway and quota counters. also grab response headers (x-rw-request-id, x-rw-rate-limit, x-rw-retry-after, x-rw-plan).

sara: sample request-id: 01GX4Y7A9BZ0KQ2M0D8F; first seen 2026-03-16T22:12:03Z. response headers pasted: 
  x-rw-request-id: 01GX4Y7A9BZ0KQ2M0D8F
  x-rw-rate-limit: 60
  x-rw-usage: 0.12
  x-rw-retry-after: 10
HAR will be uploaded shortly.

ingrid_se: if the customer can run a curl reproduction that's ideal. sample safe curl (redact key):

  curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hello"}' \
    'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate'

  add `-w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\nREQ_ID:%{header_x-rw-request-id}'` to capture code + header in output.

maria_sre: also ask them to capture a HAR from the browser or `--trace-ascii`/`--dump-header` for curl. tcpdump is fine if they can provide it (pcap or filtered).

debug-bot: automated debug bundle endpoint: `/internal/debug/collect?req=01GX4Y7A9BZ0KQ2M0D8F` returns infra logs for the req id (24h). requires support token. example: 

  curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SUPPORT_TOKEN>' 'https://internal.redwood/collect?req=01GX4Y7A9BZ0KQ2M0D8F' > acme-debug-01GX4Y7.tar.gz

tony_oncall: note: throttles are enforced across key+region. common pattern: if they hit burst gate we see evenly spaced 429s and an `x-rw-retry-after`. if it's an upstream capacity event we often see clustered 429s without retry-after. timeline of timestamps helps.

sara: uploaded HAR -> https://storage.redwood/users/sara/acme-har-1956104321.har and curl trace -> https://storage.redwood/users/sara/acme-curl-trace-1956104321.txt (api key redacted).

ingrid_se: quick look at curl trace: I see pattern: 5 successful responses then 3x 429s within ~18s. please confirm client concurrency and retry behavior (backoff params).

maria_sre: for the evidence package please include as plain text: 
  - list of request ids
  - full response headers for each entry
  - client-side ISO timestamps for each request
  - HAR or pcap/tcpdump
  - curl -v output (with `-D`/`--dump-header`)
  - account id and plan (dedicated vs shared)
we'll attach to ticket SUP-4472.

sara: provisional request ids: [01GX4Y7A9BZ0KQ2M0D8F, 01GX4Y8B2C0LKQ3N1A9Z, 01GX4Y8C3D1MLQ4O2B0Y]
timestamps: 2026-03-16T22:12:03Z, 2026-03-16T22:12:11Z, 2026-03-16T22:12:29Z
client concurrency: 4 parallel streams, exponential backoff max 2 retries.

tony_oncall: i'll pull infra logs + quota counters for those req ids and check for any recent routing/fallback events. expect initial triage in ~90m. please upload debug bundle to the ticket when available.

ingrid_se: also recommend the customer do a short controlled replay against staging: 1 minute at 2 rps single concurrency. if the replay triggers 429s, include that trace so we can rule out client-side retries.

sara: forwarding steps to customer now. i'll post artifacts here once they arrive.
